references.role: a real photograph showing a kei-truck-proportioned cab and chassis fitted with a box cargo body, for the general proportions to match (compact cab, boxy rear body on a small chassis)

props.name: Delivery Van
props.front: front three-quarter view of a small compact refrigerated delivery van with a kei-truck-proportioned cab (short bonnet, boxy cab, small wheels) and a white refrigerated box body behind it, headlights, windscreen and cab facing the viewer; plain white, no logos or readable text
props.back: rear view of the same van: the entire rear of the box body is a closed rolled-down roller shutter door (horizontal ribbed slats, like a garage roller door), with a hydraulic tail lift folded flat and stowed flush underneath the rear of the body (NOT deployed, no platform extended); plain white, no logos or text

extra_panels.title: Rear with the roller shutter door OPEN
extra_panels.description: the same rear view, but now the roller shutter door is rolled up and open, revealing the dark cargo interior; the hydraulic tail lift remains folded flat and stowed underneath, still not deployed

extra_panels.title: Parked broadside
extra_panels.description: the whole van seen parked broadside/side-on, its long axis parallel to a curb, so both the side and a clear angle on the closed rear roller door are visible together
